name: Wild Leather Helmet

faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider makes his camp at Camp Mojache, where he trades with travelers and works leather.
Camp Mojache is a Horde outpost in the forests of Feralas.

aliases: items needed for wild leather helmet
faq.answer: Jangdor Swiftstrider requires two Nightscape Tunics, two Nightscape Headbands, and a stem of Wildvine.
faq.q: What items does Jangdor Swiftstrider ask for?

sections.body: At Camp Mojache, Jangdor Swiftstrider works his craft among the Horde travelers of Feralas. To fashion a Wild Leather Helmet, he requires two Nightscape Tunics, two Nightscape Headbands, and a single stem of Wildvine. If you bring him these tailored pieces and rare jungle vines, he can finish the headpiece.
sections.title: The Crafter at Camp Mojache

summary: Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache seeks skilled materials to shape a Wild Leather Helmet. Bringing him Nightscape armor and Wildvine allows the tauren artisan to ply his craft in Feralas.
